$comment: Single source of the site's skin list. The landing-page gallery (site/index.html) and the demo skin pickers (site/demo/index.html, www/index.html) are generated from it: edit this file, then run scripts/gen-skin-list.sh. Resolutions come from skins/<id>/skin.toml. `cargo test -p oasis-backend-wasm --test site_skins` (part of the workspace tests) fails when the pages are out of step.

skins.name: PSIX HiFi
skins.blurb: High-fidelity PSIX homebrew tribute: baked ribbon wallpaper, bold psix wordmark, left-column desktop icons, media-dock footer.

skins.name: PSIX Tribute
skins.blurb: Tribute to the PSIX homebrew shell: shaped orange chrome, free desktop icons and an assemble entrance animation.

skins.name: Classic
skins.blurb: PSP-style icon grid dashboard with virtual desktops, status bar and cursor navigation.

skins.name: Altimit
skins.blurb: Vector icon dashboard inspired by the desktop OS in .hack//SIGN.

skins.name: XP
skins.blurb: Windows XP Luna-inspired blue theme with gradient titlebars and taskbar.

skins.name: Win95
skins.blurb: Windows 95/98 classic look with raised 3D borders, system gray and blue titlebars.

skins.name: macOS
